Restoration Shaman — Totemic: Corrected an issue where Oversurge did not properly increase the healing done by Surging Totem or Overflowing Shores.

Non-class: the September 3 round-up also fixed the Spark in the Night achievement not granting credit for the Sparks of War quest when completed in the Coiled Isle, Val or Naigtal; restored the Radiant Drake entrance-return NPC in Ruby Life Pools Mythic+ after the final boss; adjusted Ula’tek's Caustic Waves so they can no longer be avoided by swimming under them and corrected a Blight Vein spell description pointing at the wrong damage value; stopped the Zul’jin’s Guillotine Technique trinket effect (Perfected Guillotine) targeting out-of-combat enemies with its second target; and made The Darkwell persist for characters who have not finished the “War of Light and Shadow” campaign but completed the Arator quests for “Curse of Ula’tek”.

It reaches no tally regardless, and that is structural rather than lucky: outlookFor scores only highlights beginning “<Spec> <Class> ”, so a class-wide line is excluded from SCORING by construction (render.mjs) while still reaching the drawer's fact list via specBuildChanges. Verified empirically as well as by reading — outlook direction, source and buff/nerf counts were captured for all eleven specs across the three affected classes before and after this entry landed. Direction, source and the buff/nerf tallies are unchanged on all eleven (every one of them is verdict-driven in any case), and the Demon Hunter specs specifically hold at Havoc +7/-1, Devourer +2/-2 and Vengeance +4/-0, which is the direct evidence that the misclassified Blur line cast no vote. What DID move, for all eleven and as it should, is build MEMBERSHIP: each basis string advances from "touched in N of 21 PTR builds" to "N+1 of 22", which is the ordinary bookkeeping of adding a build they are all named in. Deliberately not distilled, as out of scope for a PvE class tracker: Delves (Mislaid Curiosities in The Darkway); the whole Dungeons and Raids section (Temple of Sethraliss' Voidbound Emissary affix despawning Galvazzt, Vashnik the Malignant's Raid Finder and Normal difficulty tuning, The Twin Fangs' Caustic Globule/Barbed Bulwark indicator timing, and The Coiled Altar's Zul'jan phase-3 killability fix — encounter tuning, not class tuning); Items (Contract: Zul'jarra's Forces Warband scope, and Sszorak's Ferocity, whose poison-tornado change is a trinket VISUAL scoped to the wearer rather than a class line); Mounts; and the PvP-only Vicious Saddle progress fix. Also swept from the same news window and correctly NOT logged: “Mythic Coiled Altar Nerfed - Race to World First” (news=382660) and the Vashnik LFR nerfs that headline the mirror itself, both encounter tuning with no class line; and the two Ion Hazzikostas interviews (Psybear news=382649, Tettles news=382637), which are design commentary rather than tuning. The Psybear interview is the only item in the window that names Patch 12.2 at all, and it does so purely as release-cadence commentary (“a plan for Patch 12.1.5, 12.2, and well beyond”) — it is NOT a 12.2 PTR announcement, and the between-cycles posture is unchanged.

All damage +8%, Brambles absorb +25%, After the Wildfire and Lunar Beam healing +25%, Ursoc's Fury absorb 35% of Thrash and Maul damage (was 30%), Elune's Favored 18% of Arcane damage (was 15%), Lunation now reduces Lunar Beam's cooldown by 20 seconds flat (was 3 seconds per Arcane ability); Elune's Chosen Boundless Moonlight Leech 12% (was 10%).

Restoration Druid — Usability pass (dev note: Tranquility, Nature's Swiftness and Incarnation, plus a punchier Swiftmend and a clearer Abundance). New talents Overgrowth and Flash of Clarity; Innervate redesigned to restore 25% of the target's mana over 8 seconds; Abundance redesigned around holding 5 Rejuvenations (+50% Regrowth crit, -50% mana); Tranquility now roots you and absorbs 60% of your health; Incarnation: Tree of Life casts Regrowth on 3 allies on shift; Swiftmend healing +40% of the consumed heal over time effect; Mastery: Harmony +15%, all healing +6%, Verdancy +40%, Wild Growth +20% with mana +15%, mana costs down on Rejuvenation (-10%), Regrowth (-10%) and Lifebloom (-20%), Passing Seasons -15 seconds (was 12); Regrowth healing -20%, Verdant Infusion no longer extends heal over time effects, Germination no longer adds 2 seconds to Rejuvenation, Nature's Splendor removed.
Evoker (class-wide) — Panacea healing +25%.

Augmentation Evoker — Apex Talent Duplicate's Upheaval casts no longer knock enemies into the air (dev note: the extra stopping power was warping dungeon gameplay); all ability and pet damage +3%; Living Flame, Verdant Embrace, Emerald Blossom, Defy Fate and Molten Blood healing +25%; Chronowarden Double-time's bonus stats now last 15 seconds and extend on reapplication; Scalecommander Wingleader redesigned — Mass Disintegrate/Mass Eruption now cut Breath of Eons by 1.5 seconds per target struck (was 1) — with Command Squadron's Pyre +40% and Maneuverability's damage over time +40%; the Midnight Season 1 2-set bonus no longer increases the duration that Eruption extends Ebon Might.

Devastation Evoker — Apex Talent Rising Fury (Rank 3) redesigned: when Dragonrage ends it persists 4 seconds per stack and Dragonrage becomes Unbound Flame, an instant 25-yard guaranteed-crit nuke castable 4 times before the cooldown finishes; Tyranny now gives Unbound Flame full Mastery: Giantkiller benefit and Risen Fury is removed. Living Flame +50%, Disintegrate +40%, Deep Breath +30%, Pyre +10%; Shattering Stars released by Scintillation now take its 40% effectiveness multiplier; Flameshaper Twin Flame damage and healing -20% (and now scales with Mastery); Scalecommander Wingleader redesigned to cut Deep Breath by 1 second per target struck (was 0.5) with Command Squadron's Pyre +40% and Maneuverability's damage over time +40%.

Preservation Evoker — Dream Breath reshaped into a flexible heal (dev note): instant healing -50%, periodic healing +118%, Apex Talent Merithra's Blessing now increases all Dream Breath healing by 60% (was 250% on the instant portion only), Font of Magic also cuts Dream Breath and Fire Breath empower time 20%, Spiritual Clarity -6 seconds cooldown (was 10), Inner Flame 50% (was 60%), Temporal Barrier absorption +30%; Flameshaper Consume Flame heals 240% of the amount consumed (was 200%) and can now be triggered by Fluttering Seedlings, but Expanded Lungs 20% (was 30%), Conduit of Flame 10% crit (was 15%), Fulminous Roar 15% (was 20%) and Twin Flame -20%.

Beast Mastery Hunter — Steady-state damage raised (dev note: BM felt weak outside Bestial Wrath windows, and Beast Cleave should hold 100% uptime). Auto Shot +720%, Cobra Shot +25%, Kill Command +20%, Barbed Shot +10%, Beast Cleave now strikes for 55% (was 40%) and lasts 10 seconds (was 8), Heart of the Pack renamed Razor Sharp (+100% pet Bite, Claw and Smack), Piercing Fangs redesigned to +15% Kill Command critical damage; Kill Cleave 20% (was 40%), Serpentine Strikes 20% (was 50%), Cobra Senses 10% (was 35%), Bloody Frenzy 33% (was 50%), Wild Instincts removed; Pack Leader Hogstrider 100% (was 200%) and Hoof and Blade 25% (was 50%); Dark Ranger Bleak Arrows +300% with Withering Fire's Black Arrow -40%.

Marksmanship Hunter — Explosive Shot redesigned and the Apex Talent moved off Aimed Shot crit (dev note). Explosive Shot now ticks every second for 3 seconds in an 8-yard area and recasting rolls remaining damage forward, with new talent Unstable Trigger, Precision Detonation (+1 second) and Windrunner Quiver redesigned; Apex Talent Take Aim (Rank 2) redesigned to +5%/10% critical damage and +3%/6% ranged damage, Rank 3 Spotter's Mark now also boosts Rapid Fire; Deathblow now comes from Aimed Shot having a chance to set up the next one, Bulletstorm redesigned (+20% next Aimed Shot after Rapid Fire), Headshot and Double Tap removed. All ability damage +5%, Auto Shot +756%, Multi-Shot +73%, Kill Shot +50%, Steady Shot +50%, Rapid Fire +44%, Arcane Shot +38%, Aimed Shot +20%, Volley +20%; Eagle's Accuracy now 1 point at 5%/10% (was 10%/20%), Focused Aim -1 second (was 2), Aspect of the Hydra no longer cleaves Arcane Shot; Dark Ranger Through the Eyes redesigned (+10% Kill Shot and Black Arrow), Black Arrow +25% but its direct damage -40%; Sentinel Moon's Blessing 1 second (was 2).

Survival Hunter — New talents Razor Edge (+10% crit chance and crit damage on Raptor Strike, Raptor Swipe and Kill Command) and Bombardier (+15% Wildfire Bomb damage, crit chance and crit damage); Wildfire Imbuement redesigned into a weapon-imbue proc, Grenade Juggler redesigned so Boomstick speeds Wildfire Bomb recovery by 60% for 8 seconds, Wildfire Shells 3 seconds (was 2), Lunge +3% Agility (was 2%) plus 1% dual-wielding (was 2%); Flamefang Pitch and Shower of Blood removed; Sentinel Open Fire redesigned to +5% Fire damage, Moon's Blessing 6 seconds of Wildfire Bomb cooldown (was 4), Sentinel's Mark 16 seconds (was 12), Lethal Barbs now a very high chance of 3 Focus per auto-attack; Pack Leader Hogstrider now lasts 1 minute (was 20 seconds) but is cancelled when a raid encounter or Mythic+ dungeon starts.

Mage (class-wide) — Defensive pass (dev note: unifying Improved Barrier across specs). New talent Improved Warding (-4% area-of-effect damage taken); Improved Prismatic Barrier, Improved Blazing Barrier and Improved Ice Barrier each now grant an extra barrier charge plus a spec rider (-5% magic damage taken, healing for 15% of the absorb, -10% physical damage taken); Temporal Realignment now heals 20% of your health immediately and 30% over 6 seconds.

Arcane Mage — New Apex Talent Prismatic Bolt replaces the old apex: Arcane Barrage has a per-Arcane-Salvo-stack chance to trigger a heavy Arcane nuke that generates 4 Arcane Charges, with ranks granting Clearcasting, +15%/30% Arcane Missiles and +15% Arcane Barrage. Arcane Pulse redesigned into a 2-second, 8-yard, 15-second-cooldown charge builder; Orb Mastery redesigned to fire 2 extra orbs at 50% effectiveness; Expanded Mind now 1 Arcane Salvo stack per Arcane Orb (was 2); Arcane Blast +20%; new defensive Refractive Images; Touch of the Archmage removed; Spellslinger Splintering Orbs +50% (was 10%) and Polished Focus refunds 3 stacks (was 5); Sunfury Glorious Incandescence summons a Meteorite every 5 stacks (was 6), Rondurmancy redesigned (+6%/12% sphere chance, spheres grant +1% spell damage), Mana Cascade uncapped, and Spellfire Sphere generation 6% for Arcane (was 12%).

Fire Mage — Steady-state damage raised against Combustion burst (dev note: time outside Combustion must stay meaningful). All damage +19%, Pyroblast +15%, Flamestrike +15%, Pyroclasm 20 seconds (was 15); Apex Talent Fired Up Rank 1 now 2% Fire damage for 8 seconds (was 4% for 12), Rank 2 5%/10% (was 3%/6%), Rank 3 chance during Combustion slightly reduced; Sunfury Ashes of Inspiration redesigned, Memory of Al'ar no longer doubles Mana Cascade stacks during Combustion, Mana Cascade uncapped and Spellfire Sphere generation 12% for Fire (was 25%).

Frost Mage — All ability and pet damage +7%; Splitting Ice second-target effectiveness 50% (was 80%) and Fractured Frost's Ice Lance second target 50% (was 100%); Glacial Bulwark no longer grants an extra Ice Barrier charge; Apex Talent Hand of Frost (Rank 2) now 0.5%/1% spell damage (was 1%/2%) — dev note: it was providing more burst than intended alongside Frost's hero talents.
Monk (class-wide) — Chi Transfer now heals for 60% of Touch of Death's damage (was 50%), Vigorous Expulsion 6% (was 5%), Silent Sanctuary healing +25%.

Brewmaster Monk — Stagger reduction from Staggering Strikes +25%, Spirit of the Ox healing-sphere chance +20%, Awakening Spirit maximum absorb +25%, Vital Flame heals for 50% of Fire or Nature damage (was 40%); Celestial Brew and Celestial Infusion absorb +150% with cooldown +100%.

Mistweaver Monk — Throughput shifted out of Spinning Crane Kick into Ancient Teachings and Mastery (dev note). All healing -3%, Mastery: Gust of Mist +50%, Jadefire Teachings 320% (was 270%), Way of the Crane 280% (was 340%), Spinning Crane Kick -7%, Morning Breeze -60%; new talent Vital Expenditure (Soothing Mist +300% healing, +200% mana, choice node with Dancing Mists); Dance of the Wind updated to a stacking 10% physical damage reduction.

Windwalker Monk — Burst pulled toward steady damage (dev note). Tiger Palm +200%, Blackout Kick +50%, Jade Ignition +50%, melee auto-attack +30%, Whirling Dragon Punch area damage +30%, Dual Threat +30%; Zenith Stomp -30%, Spinning Crane Kick -12%, Weapon of Wind 5% during Zenith (was 10%), Apex Talent Tigereye Brew (Rank 2) 5%/10% critical damage (was 10%/20%); Calming Presence -10% damage taken (was 6%), Combat Wisdom +5% Stamina, Dance of the Wind updated to a stacking 10% physical damage reduction, Vivify and Expel Harm healing +25%; Conduit of the Celestials Celestial Conduit -25% and Temple Training +30% to Fists of Fury and Spinning Crane Kick (was 10%).
Paladin (class-wide) — Golden Path, Lightforged Blessing and Brought to Light healing +25%.

Holy Paladin — All healing +19% and all damage +20% (dev note: more talent diversity, a smaller gap between Light of Dawn and other spenders, and Beacon of Virtue viability in dungeons). Word of Glory and Eternal Flame +20%, Holy Shock +10%, Judgment and Hammer of Wrath +25%, Pillar of Light's Beacon of Virtue +50%, Ringing of the Heavens casts Divine Toll at 200% (was 100%), Overflowing Light 50% (was 30%), Truth Prevails +30%, Saved by the Light +50%, Tirion's Devotion -40% Lay on Hands cooldown (was 30%), Awakening 15% (was 10%), Glistening Radiance 2% up to 6% (was 1% up to 5%), Shield of the Righteous mana return +25%; Avenging Crusader now transfers 55% of healing (was 80%) and Call of the Righteous shortens Avenging Wrath by 3 seconds (was 4); Lightsmith Divine Guidance redesigned so Holy Power casts make the next Consecration deal split Holy damage and heal 3 allies, Rite of Adjuration healing +25%.

Protection Paladin — Power moved out of cooldown windows into baseline throughput (dev note: reducing Sentinel's opportunity cost and threat pain points). Shield of the Righteous +150%, Consecration +100%, Judgment +51%, Hammer of the Righteous +50%, Lesser Weapon +50%, Avenger's Shield +30%; Hammer of Light and Empyrean Hammer -33%, Hammer and Anvil -20%, Divine Exaction's Divine Toll 80% (was 150%), Bulwark of Righteous Fury 10% per stack (was 20%), Reflection of Radiance's proc chance significantly reduced, Avenging Wrath now +10% damage and healing and +10% critical strike; new talent Blessed Word, Improved Ardent Defender redesigned (+20% maximum health, no longer cancels on fatal damage), Seal of Reprisal redesigned, Masterwork updated; Bulwark of Order 75% of Avenger's Shield (was 60%), Solace 375% (was 300%), Undying Embers 125% (was 100%), Sentinel duration 20 seconds and now inherits Avenging Wrath's critical strike bonus; Sanctified Wrath removed; Lightsmith Divine Guidance redesigned and Blessed Assurance 100% (was 200%).

Retribution Paladin — Cooldown spikes smoothed and Skyfury interactions removed (dev note). All damage -6%, Avenging Wrath +15% damage and critical strike (was 20%), Art of War now +80% Blade of Justice (was 150%) and no longer triggers from extra Skyfury attacks, Apex Talent Light Within (Rank 3) -25%, Divine Toll's Judgment +50% (was 100%); Judgment, Hammer of Wrath, Templar Strike and Templar Slash +50%, Blade of Justice +40%, Divine Storm +26%, Final Verdict +15%, Apex Talent Light Within (Rank 1) now lets Art of War and Righteous Cause each accumulate an extra charge; Crusading Strikes now increases auto-attack speed by 15% (was decreasing it 20%) and extra Skyfury attacks no longer generate Holy Power; the Season 2 tier set's Divine Arbiter now benefits from Divine Purpose and Greater Judgment (dev note: fixing an unintuitive rotational priority the tier set could create); Templar Hammer of Light -30% in PvE and now costs 3 Holy Power (was 5).

Discipline Priest — Less proc-reliant healing and more consistent damage (dev note). Shadow Mend redesigned into a passive Flash Heal upgrade rather than a Shadow Word: Pain proc; Apex Talent Master the Darkness (Rank 3) now has Mind Blast upgrade the next Power Word: Shield to Void Shield, with Penance's chance 15% (was 33%) and Void Shield absorption -28%, and can hold 2 charges; all healing and absorption +10%, Atonement 32% of damage done (was 30%), Flash Heal +25%, Smite +40%, Ultimate Penitence +30%, Greater Smite 4 seconds and 1 point (was 2 seconds); Penance no longer applies Atonement when cast on an ally; Inescapable Torment -30%; new talent Grim Deliverance; Voidweaver Void Blast +25%, Voidwraith +30% and Void Infusion 75% (was 50%); Oracle Unfolding Vision redesigned to jump expiring shields to an injured ally.

Holy Priest — All healing +16%; Apex Talent Benediction mana cost -30% and healing +15%, with Rank 3 now triggered by Holy Word: Serenity instead of Apotheosis; Divine Hymn now also grants Guardian Spirit while channeled; Flash Heal and Prayer of Healing mana -10%, Apotheosis reduces Holy Word mana cost 70% (was 50%); Archon Resonant Energy redesigned to +2% healing per Halo, stacking to 4.

Shadow Priest — Voidform reworked (dev note: more room in the rotation and less AoE reliance on Psychic Link). Voidform now grants 3 uses of Void Volley instead of putting it on cooldown, Improved Voidform redesigned (+5% spell damage and 2 extra uses), Ancient Madness redesigned into a stacking Voidform Haste and duration buff that lingers, new area talent Shadeburst; all ability damage +8%, Power Word: Shield absorb +25%; Void Volley -10%, Idol of N'Zoth now generates 2 and 6 Insanity (was 4 and 12); Phantom Menace removed; Archon Focused Outburst redesigned (Shadow Word: Madness during Voidform fires a 25% Void Volley) and Resonant Energy now +2% spell damage per Halo.

Rogue (class-wide) — Thistle Tea is now a choice talent between the existing auto-casting version and an active-only version; Atrophic Poison now reduces damage dealt by 4% (was 3%) and lasts 60 seconds (was 10, unchanged in PvP).

Assassination Rogue — Energy economy pass (dev note: refreshing Envenom late should be the best play). Apex Talent Implacable (Rank 1) redesigned — Envenom +10% damage and restores 2 Energy per combo point spent — with Rank 3 Implacable Strike +15%; all damage +20%, Shrouded Suffocation 30% (was 20%), Avulsion 25% (was 20%), Motivated Murderer 30% Energy (was 20%), Rapid Injection 20%/40% (was 15%/30%), Internal Bleeding +10%, Dashing Scoundrel now also gives +10% weapon-poison crit (was 5%) and Energy generation per lethal poison, Venomous Wounds generates more Energy on multiple bleeding targets, new talent Unstable Toxin; Deathmark 75% (was 100%), Kingsbane -15%, Blindside 10%/20% (was 15%/30%), Deadly Momentum removed; Fatebound Deal Fate 60% chance of an extra combo point on Seal Fate (was 100%).

Outlaw Rogue — Build-diversity pass (dev note: lifting underperforming talents and loosening locked-in ones). All damage +9% and Killing Spree +60%, both PvE only, with Killing Spree reworked so combo points beyond your maximum add 15% damage each instead of duration and Adrenaline Rush speeding it by 20%; Heavy Hitter 15%/30% (was 10%/20%), Summarily Dispatched 15%/30% (was 10%/20%), Fast Action -8 seconds Between the Eyes cooldown (was 5), Audacity now also +80% Ambush damage, Hidden Opportunity now matches Sinister Strike's Opportunity chance (was 80% of it) and cuts Ambush's Energy cost by 5; Improved Between the Eyes 2.5x critical damage (was 3x), Zero In 2% per stack (was 3%); Fatebound Deal Fate 60% chance of an extra combo point on Seal Fate (was 100%).

Subtlety Rogue — Resource economy pass (dev note: a double-generation bug removed, less Energy starvation outside Shadow Dance). Shadow Techniques base frequency +40% and Energy generation 5 (was 4), Shadowcraft updated so Shadow Dance raises Shadow Techniques frequency 25% and grants an extra combo point, Relentless Strikes 4 Energy per combo point (was 5); all damage +2% (PvE only), The First Dance +4 seconds Shadow Dance (was 3), Goremaw's Bite redesigned into a 3-target bleed that repeats 20% of finisher damage, Lingering Shadow now also applies to Shuriken Storm, Apex Talent Ancient Arts now counts Secret Technique's total damage when creating a shadow clone.
Shaman (class-wide) — Reactive Warding healing +25%; Ascendance has a new icon for all three specializations.

Elemental Shaman — Ascendance burst spread into baseline damage (dev note: the Ascendance and Apex effects were compounding). Chain Lightning +60%, Flame Shock +60%, Lava Burst +30% and Lightning Bolt +30% (PvE only); Ascendance now increases Elemental Overload damage by 30% (was 75%), its bonus Lava Bursts are 50% value (was 100%), Tempest direct damage -20%, Molten Wrath 10% (was 15%), Apex Talent Feedback Loop Rank 1 now +10% Elemental Overload (was 35%) plus +10% Elemental damage and Rank 2 15%/30% critical damage (was 25%/50%), Power of the Maelstrom redesigned into a stacking 20% Lava Burst buff, Stormkeeper no longer adds a Lightning Bolt overload, Elemental Blast buffs from Fusion of the Elements last 40% as long (was 100%); Farseer spirits now scale like your own spells (their Chain Lightning hits 5 targets, was 3, and their Lava Burst gains damage equal to your critical strike chance) but Ancestors' Lava Burst and Chain Lightning -20%; Stormbringer Supercharge redesigned to +10% overload damage.

Enhancement Shaman — Damage outside cooldown windows raised (dev note: Windfury and Maelstrom Weapon interactions made downtime feel weak). Melee +15%, Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning +20%, Lava Lash +15%, Stormstrike +15%; Doom Winds now increases Windfury Weapon's activation chance by 50% (was 100%); Stormbringer Tempest main-target damage -10% and secondary -30%; Totemic Surging Totem Tremor -15% and Surging Bolt -10%.

Restoration Shaman — Underperforming talents and interactions lifted (dev note), plus better Farseer Chain Heal. Unleash Life +100%, Riptide direct healing +25% and periodic +100%, Healing Rain +20% and now heals up to 6 targets (was 5) on a new 12-second cooldown with an 18-second duration, Healing Wave +10%, Acid Rain +50% though it now ticks every 2 seconds (was 1), Current Control also -15% Chain Heal mana, new talent Swelling Tides; Earthen Accord's Unleash Life bonus is now additive +20% rather than multiplicative and the Midnight Season 1 2-set bonus now increases Unleash Life's direct healing by 50% (was 100%); Farseer Ancestors' Chain Heal +50%, bouncing to 5 targets (was 3), losing 10% per jump (was 30%) at 20 yards (was 15); Totemic Pulse Capacitor 10% (was 25%) and Surging Totem's Healing Rain bonus 10% (was 20%); Calm Waters removed.

Warlock (class-wide) — Drain Life health drain +25%, Zevrim's Resilience healing +25%; a long list of abilities that were not granting Soul Leech now do (Wither, Blackened Soul, Infernal Bolt, Soul Anathema, Wicked Reaping, Unstable Affliction, Malefic Grasp, Avatar of Destruction's Chaos Bolt and several pet attacks), while Legion Strike, Cunning Cruelty and Channel Demonfire no longer erroneously grant it.

Affliction Warlock — Haunt now increases your damage to the target by 16% for 18 seconds (was 12%); new talents Hedonic Gorging (+10% Drain Life, +10% Siphon Life's Corruption bonus, Dark Harvest 10% faster and +15% damage) and Impetuous Wrath (+10%, or +20% against a Haunted target, to Shadow Bolt, Drain Soul, Malefic Grasp and Dark Harvest); Shard Instability redesigned into a 20% chance of a free instant Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption; Nocturnal Yield and Patient Zero removed; Hellcaller Blackened Soul redesigned into a single-target stack-collapse mechanic with damage +45%, Wither +25% and Mark of Peroth'arn redesigned to raise critical damage.
Demonology Warlock — Shadow Bolt +45%, Demonbolt +55%, Summon Gloomhound +35%; Diabolist Chaos Salvo, Felseeker, Wicked Cleave and Eye Explosion each -20% and Flames of Xoroth 3% (was 4%).

Destruction Warlock — All damage +4.5%, Soul Fire +45%, Chaos Bolt +5%, Conflagration of Chaos redesigned so Conflagrate and Shadowburn always critically strike and gain damage from your critical strike chance; Havoc now causes spells to deal 50% of their damage to the marked target (was 60%); Hellcaller Blackened Soul redesigned with damage +45% and Wither +25%.

Warrior (class-wide) — Rend reworked per spec (dev note: Midnight's approach did not work out). Rend is now exclusive to Arms, is single-target again and costs 10 Rage, with Cleave applying it to all targets; new talents Storm of Blood (Fury: Whirlwind applies Rend) and Blood and Thunder (Protection: Thunder Clap applies Rend); Thunder Clap no longer innately applies Rend.

Arms Warrior — Area damage spread off Cleave (dev note: Dreadnaught becomes purely AoE). Dreadnaught +100% and no longer damages the Overpower target, melee auto-attack +100%, Ravager +50% and now makes the enemies it hits take 50% more Bleed damage for 12 seconds instead of amping Cleave and Whirlwind, Ignore Pain absorb +25%, Tactical Edge redesigned so Colossus Smash grants a Sudden Death use, Broad Strokes now grants 6 Sweeping Strikes stacks, Bloodletting updated (+5% crit against Rend targets, Mortal Strike applies Rend below 35% health, Deep Wounds 33% longer); Cleave -10%, Execute -15%, Powerful Momentum 20% (was 25%), the Midnight Season 1 2-set bonus now increases Colossus Smash damage by 3% (was 5%), Improved Sweeping Strikes removed; Slayer's Dominance 25% (was 15%) and Opportunist 20% damage and 20% critical damage (was 10% each); Colossus Demolish cooldown 30 seconds (was 45), Dominance of the Colossus 20% (was 10%) but no longer reduces Demolish's cooldown, No Stranger to Pain +30% (was 20%), Tide of Battle now covers Execute as well as Overpower.

Fury Warrior — Whirlwind made useful in single target (dev note). New talent Carving Blades (+50% Whirlwind damage against a single target), Whirlwind now generates 3 Rage innately with Improved Whirlwind adjusted accordingly, Rampaging Ruin redesigned so Rampage's final strike slams for area damage, Hack and Slash now a 75% chance to refund a Raging Blow charge and boost the next one 20%, Bloodbath initial damage -12% with bleed damage +300% (dev note: intended to be net neutral); Mountain Thane Ground Current +150% and Thunder Blast +20% while Crashing Thunder's Thunder Clap bonus drops to 10% (was 30%).

Protection Warrior — All ability damage +11%; Revenge damage +20% and its free-cast proc now also comes from auto-attacks (dev note: shrinking the dungeon-versus-raid proc-rate gap); Ravager +50% and now makes the enemies it hits take 50% more Bleed damage for 12 seconds instead of amping Revenge and Thunder Clap; Ignore Pain absorb +25%, Fueled by Violence 125% of Bleed damage (was 110%), Brutal Vitality 10% (was 8%), Unyielding +6% Defensive Stance reduction (was 4%), Devastating Focus now also covers Execute and Bloodborne now increases all Bleed damage; Colossus Practiced Strikes 4 Rage (was 3), Tide of Battle now covers Execute, No Stranger to Pain +30% (was 20%), Dominance of the Colossus 20% (was 10%) but no longer reduces Demolish's cooldown, Demolish cooldown 30 seconds (was 45).

builds.label: Follow-up notes (forum post #19): Vaults of Atal'utek Corrosive Souls tracking + Omnium Folio questline account-wide skip (no class tuning)
highlights: Non-class: Vaults of Atal'utek — the Corrosive Codex now shows a counter for Corrosive Souls, tracking how many are in the character's inventory.
Non-class: The Omnium Folio introduction questline can now be skipped on other characters once any character on the account has completed it.

builds.label: Week of July 31st — Class Tuning & Tier Sets: broad PvE tuning across Death Knight (San'layn Blood pullback, Unholy AoE-to-melee shift), Demon Hunter (Havoc buffs / Devourer cleave trim), Druid (Balance nerf, Guardian +8%), Devastation Evoker (Scintillation fix + baseline compensation), Hunter (BM/MM cuts), Mage (Arcane single-target, Fire +6%, Frost set + cleave trims), Paladin/Priest Holy healing +5%, Shadow spread-cleave trim, Rogue aura buffs to all three specs, Elemental Shaman Farseer Ancestor cuts, Warlock single-target buffs with a Destruction cleave trim, and Warrior (Arms trim + set rework, Protection +6%); plus Venomous Abyss tier-set changes, Season 2 Delve/Ritual Site/Void Assault reward updates and PvP tuning.
highlights: Blood Death Knight — San'layn pullback (dev note: overperforming in AoE and low target cleave): Blood is Life now accumulates 15% of the damage dealt from the Blood Beast (was 25%); Frenzied Bloodthirst's Death Strike and Death Coil damage bonus reduced to 5% per stack (was 6%); Visceral Strength now grants 10% Strength (was 12%).

Unholy Death Knight — Area damage reined in and personal melee raised (dev note): auto-attack damage increased by 100%; Virulent Plague -10%, Epidemic -12%, Apex Talent Forbidden Knowledge Graveyard -15%; The Venomous Abyss set bonus — damage of Necrotic Bolt and Withering Grasp increased by 25%.

Havoc Demon Hunter — Dev note: "Havoc is a little further behind in damage than our target." Blade Dance, Death Sweep, Chaos Strike and Annihilation damage each increased by 6%; The Hunt +12%; Essence Break initial damage +10% and secondary damage +30%.
Devourer Demon Hunter — Low-target cleave trimmed: Eradicate secondary target damage reduced by 15%; Annihilator: Final Hour now causes Voidfall bonuses to persist for 6 seconds (was 8 seconds).

Balance Druid — Dev note: overall damage reduced with a slightly larger cut to spread cleave, which remains a Balance strength. Moonfire and Sunfire -5%, Shooting Stars -10%, Starsurge and Starfall -3%, Meteorites -15%.
Guardian Druid — All damage increased by 8%.

Devastation Evoker — Scintillation interaction fixed and the set corrected, with baseline compensation (dev note): Shattering Stars released from Eternity Surge via Scintillation are now subject to Scintillation's 40% effectiveness multiplier; The Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus — Shattering Star damage bonus reduced to 50% (was 150%); Deep Breath +30%, Pyre +10%, Disintegrate +40%, Living Flame +50%.
Beast Mastery Hunter — Cobra Shot damage reduced by 20%.
Marksmanship Hunter — Dev note: bug fixes had increased its damage, so tuning realigns it with other DPS specs. All damage dealt by you and your pets reduced by 5%; Explosive Shot -33%.

Arcane Mage — Dev note: AoE is fine but single target is behind target. Arcane Blast damage increased by 20%; Spellslinger: Splintering Orbs damage bonus to Arcane Orb increased to 50% (was 10%); Sunfury: fixed Meteorites not granting Clearcasting.
Fire Mage — All damage increased by 6%.

Frost Mage — Dev note: the tier set was providing more throughput than intended and 2-target cleave was slightly high, so both are trimmed alongside an overall damage increase. The Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus — Glacial Spike damage bonus reduced to 20% (was 25%), chance to generate an Icicle per Freezing stack Shattered reduced to 4% (was 5%); The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus — Shatter damage bonus reduced to 5% (was 10%); Splitting Ice — Flurry and Frostbolt effectiveness against the second target reduced to 50% (was 80%); Fractured Frost — Ice Lance effectiveness against the second target reduced to 50% (was 100%); all damage increased by 3%.
Holy Paladin — All healing increased by 5%.
Holy Priest — All healing increased by 5%.

Shadow Priest — Spread-cleave pullback (dev note: Shadow is expected to keep excelling there afterwards). Void Volley damage reduced by 10%; The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus now causes Tentacle Slam to grant a free use of Void Volley at 100% effectiveness (was 125%); Archon: Focused Outburst now increases Void Volley damage by 5% (was 15%).
Assassination Rogue — All damage dealt increased by 10%.
Outlaw Rogue — All damage dealt increased by 6%. This does not apply to PvP combat.
Subtlety Rogue — All damage dealt increased by 10%. This does not apply to PvP combat.

Elemental Shaman — Dev note: Farseer's Ancestor spells are performing higher than wanted after their earlier boost. Farseer: Ancestors' Lava Burst damage reduced by 20%; Farseer: Ancestors' Chain Lightning damage reduced by 20%.
Affliction Warlock — Haunt now increases your damage dealt to the target by 16% for 18 seconds (was 12%).

Protection Warrior All ability damage increased by 5%; Revenge +20%; Mountain Thane Thunder Blast +10%.

Restoration Druid Regrowth buff, a Preservation Evoker raid-to-triage rebalance, Mistweaver -8% all healing against a Gust of Mist buff, Holy Paladin Holy Shock +50%, Discipline Priest Penance and Shadow Mend buffs against an Atonement mass-healing falloff and a Void Shield trim, and Holy Priest Prayer of Mending +20%.
highlights: Restoration Druid — Regrowth healing increased by 25%; Abundance increases the critical strike chance of Regrowth by 60% (was 50%) and reduces its cost by 60% (was 50%).

Dream Breath healing over time reduced by 25%; Merithra's Blessing healing reduced by 10%; Reverberations causes Verdant Embrace to heal for 40% over 8 sec (was 60%); the class set triggers Living Flame at 100% value (was 150%). Holy Paladin — Holy Shock healing increased by 50%; Holy Shock mana cost decreased by 11%.

Discipline Priest — Penance damage and healing increased by 15%; Grim Deliverance now increases Shadow Mend healing by 40% (was 30%) and increases its cast time by 0.3 seconds (was 0.5 seconds). Holy Priest — Prayer of Mending healing increased by 20%; Oracle: Prompt Prognosis healing increased by 30%.

highlights: Havoc Demon Hunter Inertia effect now increases damage by 12% for 6 seconds (was 18% for 5 seconds).

Preservation Evoker Fixed Time Dilation not clearing its stored damage on death (bug fix).
Beast Mastery Hunter Beast Cleave can no longer be cancelled.
Marksmanship Hunter Explosive Shot damage increased by 100%, but now only explodes for 50% of the damage done to other nearby enemies.
Survival Hunter Flamefang Pitch has been removed; new talent Bombardier increases Wildfire Bomb damage, critical strike chance, and critical damage by 15%.
Survival Hunter Wildfire Shells now grants 5 seconds of Wildfire Bomb cooldown reduction (was 2 seconds); Lunge now increases Agility by 3% (was 2%).
Survival Hunter The Venomous Abyss 2-set and 4-set bonuses reworked around Mongoose Fury and Boomstick; Pack Leader Hogstrider now lasts 1 minute (was 20 seconds).
Arcane Mage Fixed Refractive Images not clearing its stored damage on death (bug fix).
Fire Mage The Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus — fixed a Pyroblast Hot Streak critical-strike interaction with Pyroclasm (bug fix).

Protection Paladin Hammer and Anvil damage reduced by 20%; Bulwark of Righteous Fury now increases Shield of the Righteous damage by 10% per stack (was 20%); 4-set now deals 100% additional damage on a critical strike (was 200%).
Holy Priest Flash Heal and Prayer of Healing mana costs reduced by 10%; Apex Talent Benediction healing increased by 15% and its availability spread beyond Apotheosis.
Shadow Priest Idol of N’Zoth now generates 2 Insanity (was 4) at 50 stacks and 6 (was 12) at 100 stacks; Archon Focused Outburst Void Volley now 25% effectiveness (was 100%).
Restoration Shaman Healing Rain healing increased by 20% and Healing Wave by 10%, while Totemic bonuses to Healing Rain were lowered (Surging Totem now +10%, was +20%).
Affliction Warlock New talent Hedonic Gorging (+10% Drain Life, Siphon Life adds +10% Corruption damage, Dark Harvest channels 10% faster and +15% damage); Patient Zero has been removed.
Destruction Warlock All damage reduced by 5%; the Venomous Abyss 4-set now makes targets hit by Echo of Sargeras take 6% increased damage from your spells and abilities.

Outlaw Rogue Killing Spree reworked — duration no longer increases from spending combo points beyond your maximum; each extra combo point now increases damage by 15%, and Adrenaline Rush speeds up its execution by 20%.
Systems (not spec-scored) — Season 2 Corrosive Power / Coiled Isle soul system, all Season 2 dungeons on M0/M+ for testing, Mythic Venomous Abyss raid testing continues, plus PvP and UI notes.
Shadow Priest — The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus has been redesigned: Tentacle Slam has a 100% chance to grant a free use of Void Volley at 125% effectiveness.

Destruction Warlock — All damage increased by 10%.
Devourer Demon Hunter — All ability damage increased by 10% (Havoc Demon Hunter −5%).
Balance Druid — All damage +3.5% with DoT/builder buffs (Moonfire / Sunfire / Wrath +10%, Starfire +20%) so its profile isn't purely spender-driven.
Retribution Paladin — All damage reduced by 6%; the Venomous Abyss 4-set reworked around Divine Arbiter (damage +35%).

Evoker — Scalecommander's Wingleader redesigned (per-target Deep Breath / Breath of Eons CDR replaces the old spread-Bombardment mechanic), with Command Squadron and Maneuverability buffed to compensate.

Frost Death Knight All ability damage reduced by 10%; melee damage reduced by 20%; Icy Death Torrent damage reduced by 35%; Remorseless Winter damage reduced by 30%; Obliterate damage reduced by 10%.

Unholy Death Knight All damage reduced by 8%; Lord of the Dead damage reduced by 25%; Magus of the Dead reduced by 15%; all Lesser Ghoul damage reduced by 15%; Putrefy reduced by 15%; Necrotic Coil reduced by 18%; Pestilence, Infected Claw, and Virulent Plague reduced by 25%; Rider of the Apocalypse Whitemane Death Coil and Whitemane Undeath reduced by 25%.
Devourer Demon Hunter All ability damage increased by 10%.

Balance Druid All damage dealt increased by 3.5%; Moonfire, Sunfire, Shooting Stars, and Wrath damage increased by 10%; Starfire damage increased by 20%; Umbral Intensity now increases Wrath and Starfire damage by 12% (was 10%); Meteorites damage increased by 15%; Apex Talent: Ascendant Eclipses' Solar Bolt and Lunar Bolt damage increased by 10%; Keeper of the Grove Sylvan Beckoning Dryad's Starfall to 250% effectiveness (was 200%) and Spirit of the Thicket increases Starfall damage by 18% (was 12%).
Restoration Druid Mastery: Harmony healing bonus increased by 15%.

Outlaw Rogue — The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus: chance to activate increased to 20% (was 12%), and it can no longer activate from Sinister Strike's additional Opportunity hits.
Enhancement Shaman — The Venomous Abyss 2-set bonus has been updated: Fire Nova deals 200% increased damage to the primary target of your Voltaic Blaze.
Restoration Shaman — The Venomous Abyss 4-set bonus has been updated: Condensation value increased by 300%.

Vengeance Demon Hunter Sigil of Chains no longer replaces Sigil of Misery and its cooldown is reduced to 60 seconds (was 90 seconds); Sigil of Silence now replaces Sigil of Misery when selected; Improved Sigil of Misery no longer affects Sigil of Chains and now reduces Sigil of Silence's cooldown by 15 seconds when it is selected.
Druid (class-wide) Shred and Cat Form Swipe damage increased by 10%.

Balance Druid The Orbit Breaker counter aura can no longer be manually cancelled to reset progress; Elune's Chosen Lunar Calling's Starfire bonus has been reverted to 120%, Star Cascade no longer triggers off gaining Astral Power with Wrath, and Bask in Moonlight increases Starsurge damage by 5% (was 10%).

Feral Druid Merciless Claws and Rampant Ferocity have swapped positions in the talent tree; Merciless Claws increases Shred and Swipe damage by 25% (was 20%); Taste for Blood increases Ferocious Bite damage by 16% (was 12%) and another 8% during Tiger's Fury (was 12%); all damage dealt increased by 3%.
Guardian Druid Fixed an issue where Wild Guardian was not correctly increasing Thrash and Mangle damage while a spirit was active.
Marksmanship Hunter Explosive Shot damage increased by 15%, moving more of the tier set bonus into the base ability to increase its baseline value.

Mage (class-wide) Improved Prismatic Barrier redesigned - Prismatic Barrier gains an additional charge and further reduces magic damage taken by 5%; Improved Blazing Barrier redesigned - an additional charge that also heals you for 15% of the damage it absorbs; Improved Ice Barrier redesigned - an additional charge that also reduces physical damage taken by 10%.

Arcane Mage New Talent: Refractive Images - 10% of damage you would take is instead dealt over 8 seconds, increased to 30% for 15 seconds after casting Mirror Image; Orb Mastery redesigned - casting Arcane Orb fires 2 additional orbs at 50% effectiveness; Expanded Mind now grants 1 stack of Arcane Salvo on Arcane Orb (was 2); Spellslinger Polished Focus now refunds 3 Arcane Salvo stacks (was 5); Amplification and Improved Clearcasting moved in the talent tree.

Holy Paladin Eternal Flame and Word of Glory healing increased by 15%; all damage increased by 20%; Judgment and Hammer of Wrath damage increased by 25%; Avenging Crusader now transfers 55% of healing done (was 80%); Pillar of Light's Beacon of Virtue healing increased by 50%; Shield of the Righteous mana return increased by 25%; Unworthy debuff now lasts 18 seconds (was 15 seconds).

Protection Paladin Greater Judgment debuff now lasts 18 seconds (was 15 seconds); Guardian of Ancient Kings now has a 0.5 second cooldown; fixed Seal of Reprisal reducing damage dealt to the target rather than to the caster, Sacred Weapon and Holy Bulwark extending duration incorrectly, Authoritative Rebuke incorrectly reducing Rebuke's cooldown from Avenger's Shield, and Instrument of the Divine extending Sentinel's stacks incorrectly; many talents moved rows.
Retribution Paladin Greater Judgment debuff now lasts 18 seconds (was 15 seconds); Divine Arbiter damage now benefits from Divine Purpose and Greater Judgment.
Assassination Rogue Lethality and Cold Blooded-Killer now work correctly with the strikes dealt by Implacable Rank 3.

Outlaw Rogue Audacity now also increases Ambush damage by 60%; Hidden Opportunity also reduces Ambush's Energy cost by 5; Killing Spree shots now have a higher chance to target your selected target when valid; new connectors added between Ruthlessness and Find an Opening and between the Flickering Steel choice node and Grand Melee.

Subtlety Rogue Goremaw's Bite redesigned - lash out at your target and 2 additional nearby enemies for Shadow damage and a 14-second bleed, repeating 10% of all Finishing Move damage split evenly among affected enemies; The First Dance now increases Shadow Dance duration by 4 seconds (was 3 seconds); Shadow Techniques' base effect frequency increased by 40% and its Energy generation increased to 5 (was 4); Shadowcraft no longer causes Shadow Techniques to generate additional Energy and now triggers it 25% more frequently while active (was 75%).
Warlock (class-wide) Hellcaller Blackened Soul damage increased by 45% and Wither damage increased by 25%, in response to the previous week's Hellcaller functionality changes.

Arms Warrior Tactical Edge redesigned - Colossus Smash immediately grants 1 use of Sudden Death; Ravager now causes enemies it damages to take 50% increased damage from your bleeds for 12 seconds (was 25%).

Protection Warrior Revenge updated - successful dodges, parries, and auto-attacks now have a chance to make your next Revenge cost no Rage (was only dodges and parries); Ravager now causes enemies it damages to take 50% increased damage from your bleeds for 12 seconds (was 25%).

Blood Death Knight (Not Yet Implemented) The Venomous Abyss 2-set - Death Strike grants a stack of Blood Debt increasing Strength by 0.5% up to 5%, and at 10 stacks your next Marrowrend consumes it for 10% Strength for 10 seconds; (Not Yet Implemented) 4-set - consuming Blood Debt makes your next Marrowrend generate 3 additional Boneshield and deal Shadow damage to your target and nearby enemies. Shared early for feedback ahead of implementation.

builds.label: Weekly PTR build: class tuning wave (Frost/Unholy DK rebalance, Enhancement Shaman steady-state buffs), Earthen exploration XP nerf, Heroic raid/Lair/Altar of Fangs testing, Housing enabled Per-spec and class-wide lines backfilled 2026-08-01 from the original forum post (the entry was under-distilled at seeding). highlights: Frost Death Knight — Howling Blast damage increased by 100%. This does not apply to PvP combat.
Frost Death Knight — Obliterate damage reduced by 25%. This does not apply to PvP combat.
Unholy Death Knight — Blightburst now causes Putrefy to extend the duration of plagues by 3 seconds (was 4.5 seconds).
Havoc Demon Hunter — Blind Fury now causes Eye Beam to generate 10/20 Fury per second (was 15/30 Fury).
Enhancement Shaman — Doom Winds now increases the chance of Windfury Weapon activating by 50% (was 100%).
Arms Warrior — Ignore Pain absorb increased by 25%.

Frost Death Knight Pillar of Frost now increases Strength by 20% (was 30%); Howling Blast, Icy Death Torrent, Frost Fever, and Remorseless Winter damage increased by 100%; Empower Rune Weapon and Glacial Advance damage increased by 30%; Frost Strike damage increased by 25%; Frostscythe damage increased by 20%; Obliterate damage reduced by 25%; Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury damage reduced by 20%; Frostbane damage reduced by 30%; Permafrost grants a shield equal to 35% of damage dealt (was 30%); Deathbringer Wither Away now 75% faster (was 100%), Deathly Blows now increases Frost Strike damage by 35% (was 15%), Reaper's Mark reduced by 25%, Exterminate reduced by 17%; Rider of the Apocalypse Whitemane's Undeath reduced by 30%. None of these apply to PvP combat.

Unholy Death Knight Blightburst now causes Putrefy to extend the duration of plagues by 3 seconds (was 4.5 seconds); Runic Power spenders now extend plague duration by 1 second (was 1.5); Dread Plague now retains its extended duration when applied to a new target within 40 yards of the Death Knight.

Havoc Demon Hunter Trail of Ruin damage is now applied immediately rather than over 4 seconds; Serrated Glaive is now a 12-second buff on the Demon Hunter rather than a 15-second debuff on enemies; Blind Fury now causes Eye Beam to generate 10/20 Fury per second (was 15/30); Inner Demon has moved and is now a choice node option with Chaos Theory.

Vengeance Demon Hunter Sigil of Chains is now learned at level 35 and is no longer a talent; Roaring Fire has moved to Sigil of Chains' old location; Sigil of Silence and Feed the Demon have swapped positions in the talent tree.

Guardian Druid Apex Talent: Wild Guardian updated - bonus Rage moved from rank 1 to rank 3, base chance adjusted to 10%, spirit Rage generation increased to 8, and rank 3 now grants one guaranteed spirit and increases Thrash and Mangle damage while a spirit is active.
Evoker (class-wide) Panacea healing increased by 25%.
Augmentation Evoker Defy Fate healing increased by 25%; Molten Blood healing increased by 25%.
Monk (class-wide) Silent Sanctuary healing increased by 25%.
Windwalker Monk Expel Harm healing increased by 25%.

Protection Paladin Hammer of Light, Divine Resonance, Sacrosanct Crusade, Bulwark of Order, Blessed Word, Empyreal Ward, Strength in Adversity, and Seal of Reprisal can now be tracked with the Cooldown Manager.
Shaman (class-wide) Reactive Warding healing increased by 25%.

Elemental Shaman Stormkeeper updated and no longer causes Lightning Bolt to generate an additional Elemental Overload; Blizzard clarified that the previous week's note describing a Stormkeeper redesign was confusing, and that this is the only Stormkeeper change between 12.0.7 and 12.1.

Enhancement Shaman Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning damage increased by 20%; Lava Lash, Stormstrike, and melee damage increased by 15%; Doom Winds now increases the chance of Windfury Weapon activating by 50% (was 100%); Stormbringer Tempest main target damage reduced by 10% and secondary target damage reduced by 30%; Totemic Surging Totem Tremor damage reduced by 15% and Surging Bolt reduced by 10%.
Warlock (class-wide) Drain Life health drain increased by 25%; Zevrim's Resilience healing increased by 25%.
Arms Warrior Ignore Pain absorb increased by 25%.

Retribution Paladin Radiance of the Concentrated Flame 4-set bonus updated - consuming Divine Purpose with Divine Storm causes your next 2 Templar's Verdicts to unleash Divine Arbiter at its target, dealing Holy damage and Holy damage to enemies within 8 yards. Dev note: granting free Templar's Verdict casts after consuming Divine Purpose impacted the Holy Power economy more than intended.

builds.label: Initial 12.1 Curse of Ula'tek PTR development notes: full patch notes covering all 13 classes, +25% player health/creature damage, DPS cooldown throughput reductions, new raid/dungeon/Lairs/Housing/Discord features Per-spec and class-wide lines for all 13 classes were backfilled 2026-08-01 from the original forum post: the entry originally carried only 6 marquee lines against 39 specsAffected, so 30 specs' 12.1 changes reached no drawer. highlights: Devourer Demon Hunter — Mastery: Monster Within has been updated – Bonus damage during Void Metamorphosis reduced by 66%.
Demon Hunter (class-wide) — Demon Hunters can now equip daggers.
Blood Death Knight — Permafrost grants a shield equal to 50% of damage dealt (was 40%).
Restoration Druid — All spell and ability healing increased by 6%.

Warrior (class-wide) — The Rend ability is now exclusive to Arms, has returned to being a single-target ability, and its Rage cost is reduced to 10. Cleave will apply Rend to all targets if the Warrior knows Rend.
Destruction Warlock — Conflagration of Chaos has been redesigned – Conflagrate and Shadowburn have a 100% chance to critically strike, and their damage is increased by your critical strike chance.

Blood Death Knight Permafrost grants a shield equal to 50% of damage dealt (was 40%); Voracious grants 15% Leech (was 12%); Relish in Blood healing increased by 25%; Rapid Decomposition increases Blood Plague healing by 85% (was 50%); Sanguinary Burst heals you for 18% of damage dealt (was 15%); Umbilicus Eternus absorbs 6 times Blood Plague damage (was 5). Self-sustain rescaling alongside the +25% player-health change.
Frost Death Knight Permafrost grants a shield equal to 35% of damage dealt (was 30%). Self-sustain rescaling alongside the +25% player-health change.

Unholy Death Knight Reanimation renamed to Lord of the Dead and redesigned - controlling 3 Magus of the Dead sacrifices them to summon their Lord of the Dead for 15 seconds, casting Frostbolts that chain between 2 enemies; Army of the Dead redesigned - summons or empowers Lesser Ghouls into an army of 8 for 30 seconds, commanded through Scourge Strike as Death Order or Epidemic Order; Soul Reaper no longer consumes Putrefy charges and now consumes up to 3 Lesser Ghoul stacks to summon them instantly; Unholy Aura's Magus of the Dead now grant Haste on spawn for 15 seconds; Menacing Magus makes Lord of the Dead Frostbolts chain to 3 additional enemies.

Unholy Death Knight Apex Talent: Forbidden Knowledge (Rank 3) updated - Magus of the Dead no longer grants stacking damage to Necrotic Coil and Graveyard, and Putrefy activated by Dread Plague increased to 100% effectiveness (was 60%); Necrotic Coil and Graveyard damage increased by 20%; Lesser Ghoul damage increased by 10%; Army of the Dead Lesser Ghoul damage reduced by 20%; Commander of the Dead now increases summoned creature damage by 10%/20% for 30 seconds (was 15%/30%); Ruptured Viscera now deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets; other players now see at most 3 Lesser Ghouls.

Devourer Demon Hunter All ability damage increased by 20%; Void Metamorphosis now increases Void Ray damage by 40% (was 67%); Impending Apocalypse now grants 20% increased damage to the next Collapsing Star (was 30%); Consume damage increased by 60% (does not affect Devour).

Havoc Demon Hunter Demon Blades, Blade Dance, and Chaos Strike now require equipped Warglaives, Axes, Swords, or Fist Weapons; New Talent: Never Say Die - damage increased by 3% while above 50% health, Leech increased by 5% while below 50% health; Dash of Chaos has been removed.

Vengeance Demon Hunter Fracture and Soul Cleave now require equipped Warglaives, Axes, Swords, or Fist Weapons; Charred Warblades heals you for 5% of Fire damage dealt (was 4%); Soul Cleave, Fel Devastation, and Feast of Souls healing increased by 25%; Frailty heals you for 10% of damage dealt to afflicted targets (was 8%); Revel in Pain shields you for 6% of your Fire damage (was 5%). Self-sustain rescaling alongside the +25% player-health change.
Druid (class-wide) Matted Fur absorb increased by 25%; Heart of the Wild empowered Wild Growth healing increased by 25%.

Balance Druid New passive learned at level 42: Stellar Protection - dispelling Moonfire and Sunfire applies Stellar Flare and generates 12 Astral Power; Umbral Intensity now increases Wrath and Starfire damage by 10% at all times; Apex Talent: Ascendant Eclipses (Rank 2) Astral Smolder reduced to 10%/20% of critical strike damage (was 12%/24%) with duration increased to 8 seconds (was 6); all damage dealt increased by 4%; Starsurge and Starfall damage increased by 10%; Celestial Fire increased to 10% (was 8%); Orbit Breaker effectiveness reduced to 50% (was 60%); Touch the Cosmos trigger chance reduced to 12% from Wrath (was 15%) and 15% from Starfire (was 20%); Total Eclipse increased to 15%/30% (was 10%/20%); Sculpt the Stars reduces Eclipse cooldown by 3 seconds (was 2); Elune's Chosen Lunar Calling reduced to 100% (was 120%); Keeper of the Grove Bounteous Bloom now extends Treant duration by 4 seconds instead of adding a fourth Treant, Cenarius' Might reduced to 6% (was 8%), Potent Enchantments reduced to 6% (was 10%).

Feral Druid Saber Jaws damage bonus increased to 60% per point (was 50%); Focused Frenzy reduced to 15% (was 20%); Rip and Tear increased to 20% (was 15%); Chomp damage increased by 30%; Apex Predator's Craving base chance to trigger reduced to 4% (was 5%).

Guardian Druid Gory Fur has been redesigned - Ironfur has a chance to make your next Maul, Raze, or Ravage free, and Maul, Raze, or Ravage have a chance to make your next Ironfur free; Apex Talent: Wild Guardian has been redesigned (not yet implemented) - spending Rage can awaken a Guardian Spirit for 8 seconds that generates 3 Rage when you cast Thrash or Mangle, Mangle and Maul deal 20%/40% additional Nature damage over 12 seconds and increase Mastery by 3%/6%, and Berserk or Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc grants 2 charges of Wild Guardian.

Guardian Druid Lunation reduces Lunar Beam's cooldown by 20 seconds (was 3 seconds per Arcane ability); Brambles absorb increased by 25%; After the Wildfire healing increased by 25%; Ursoc's Fury grants an absorb for 35% of Thrash and Maul damage (was 30%); Elune's Favored heals you for 18% of Arcane damage dealt (was 15%); Lunar Beam healing increased by 25%; Elune's Chosen Boundless Moonlight Leech increased to 12% (was 10%).

Restoration Druid New Talents Overgrowth (Nature's Swiftness causes your next Regrowth to apply Lifebloom, Rejuvenation, and Wild Growth's heal over time) and Flash of Clarity (Omen of Clarity increases Regrowth's healing by 40%); Innervate redesigned - now regenerates 25% of the target's maximum mana over 8 seconds rather than making spells free; Abundance redesigned - with at least 5 Rejuvenations active, Regrowth gains 50% critical strike chance and 50% reduced mana cost; Tranquility now grows protective roots absorbing 60% of your health and preventing knockbacks; Incarnation: Tree of Life now casts Regrowth on up to 3 injured allies on shapeshift; Swiftmend healing increased by 40% of the consumed heal over time effect; Everbloom (Rank 3) now triggers on Swiftmend; Verdant Infusion no longer extends heal over time effects; Germination no longer increases Rejuvenation duration; Ysera's Gift overhealing now transfers to a nearby ally; Wild Growth healing increased by 20% with mana cost increased by 15%; Verdancy healing increased by 40%; Nature's Splendor removed.

Augmentation Evoker Apex Talent: Duplicate - Upheaval casts by your Duplicate no longer knock enemies into the air; Chronowarden Double-time updated - stats granted when Ebon Might critically strikes now last 15 seconds (modified by Mastery: Timewalker) rather than the full Ebon Might duration.

Devastation Evoker Rising Fury (Rank 3) redesigned - when Dragonrage ends it persists 4 seconds per stack and Dragonrage becomes Unbound Flame, a new instant 25-yard spell that critically strikes for Fire damage to your target and nearby enemies (reduced beyond 5 targets), causes 1 Essence Burst, and may be cast 4 times before Dragonrage finishes its cooldown; Tyranny now causes Unbound Flame to always gain the maximum benefit of Mastery: Giantkiller; Risen Fury removed.

Preservation Evoker Merithra's Blessing updated - now increases all healing of Dream Breath by 60% (was 250%, and previously applied only to its instant healing); Font of Magic now also reduces the empower time of Dream Breath and Fire Breath by 20%; Dream Breath instant healing reduced by 50% and periodic healing increased by 118%; Temporal Barrier absorption increased by 30%.

Hunter (class-wide) Ranged auto-shot damage increased by 600%; Hunter's Mark can now be applied to up to 5 targets (was 1); Dark Ranger Bleak Arrows damage increased by 300% and Withering Fire's Black Arrow damage reduced by 40%.

Beast Mastery Hunter Heart of the Pack renamed to Razor Sharp and redesigned - increases the damage of your pet's Bite, Claw, and Smack by 100%; Piercing Fangs redesigned - Kill Command critical damage increased by 15%; Bloody Frenzy now reduces Barbed Shot's periodic rate increase by 33% (was 50%); Kill Cleave now cleaves 20% of Kill Command's damage during Beast Cleave (was 40%); Barbed Shot damage increased by 25%; Kill Command and Cobra Shot damage increased by 20%; Beast Cleave duration increased to 10 seconds (was 8); Wild Instincts removed.

Marksmanship Hunter Explosive Shot redesigned - now explodes every 1 second for 3 seconds dealing Fire damage within 8 yards (reduced beyond 5 targets), and recasting incorporates remaining damage; New Talent: Unstable Trigger - Explosive Shot can be used a second time within 3 seconds; Precision Detonation redesigned to extend Explosive Shot by 1 second; Shrapnel Shot renamed to Incendiary Ammunition (reduces Explosive Shot's cooldown by 10 seconds); Deathblow updated - Aimed Shot now has a chance to cause your NEXT Aimed Shot to grant Deathblow; Bulletstorm redesigned - Rapid Fire increases your next Aimed Shot damage by 20%; Aspect of the Hydra no longer causes Arcane Shot to cleave; Double Tap and Headshot removed.

Marksmanship Hunter Apex Talent: Take Aim (Rank 2) redesigned - critical strike damage increased by 5%/10% and ranged ability damage by 3%/6% (no longer a guaranteed Aimed Shot critical); Take Aim (Rank 3) Spotter's Mark now boosts Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire (was Aimed Shot only); Aimed Shot, Rapid Fire, Arcane Shot, Multi-Shot, and Kill Shot damage increased by 20%; Eagle's Accuracy is now 1 point granting 5% Aimed Shot (was 10%) and 10% Rapid Fire (was 20%); Focused Aim reduces Aimed Shot's cooldown by 1 second (was 2); Dark Ranger Through the Eyes redesigned to +10% Kill Shot and Black Arrow damage, Black Arrow direct damage reduced by 40%; Sentinel Moon's Blessing reduced to 1 second of Aimed Shot cooldown reduction (was 2).

Survival Hunter New Talent: Razor Edge - Raptor Strike, Raptor Swipe, and Kill Command gain 10% increased critical strike chance and 10% increased critical damage; Primal Surge moved to an easier location in the talent tree; Shower of Blood removed; Sentinel Lethal Barbs updated - auto-attacks now have a very high chance to generate 3 Focus rather than 1 per attack; Scout's Vigil no longer increases stealth detection radius during Camouflage.

Mage (class-wide) New Talent: Improved Warding - damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 4%; Improved Prismatic Barrier now grants an additional charge of Prismatic Barrier; Temporal Realignment now immediately heals 20% of your health and 30% more over 6 seconds; Sunfury Rondurmancy redesigned - Spellfire Sphere generation chance increased by 6%/12% and each Sphere grants an additional 1% spell damage rather than granting 5 orbs; Ashes of Inspiration redesigned - each Phoenix spell grants 1 stack of Mana Cascade; Memory of Al'ar no longer doubles Mana Cascade stacks from Combustion and Arcane Surge; Spellfire Spheres generation reduced to 6% for Arcane and 12% for Fire (was 12% and 25%); Mana Cascade stack cap removed.

Arcane Mage New Apex Talent: Prismatic Bolt - Arcane Barrage has a 1% chance per Arcane Salvo stack consumed to trigger a devastating Arcane hit that generates 4 Arcane Charges, with Rank 2 granting Clearcasting and +15%/30% Arcane Missiles damage and Rank 3 adding Arcane Salvo chance and +15% Arcane Barrage damage; Arcane Pulse redesigned - cast time 2 seconds (was 2.25), radius 8 yards (was 2), now a 15-second cooldown generating 1 Arcane Charge per enemy struck and costing 10% base mana, no longer scaling with Arcane Charges; Expanded Mind now grants 4 Arcane Salvo stacks on Prismatic Bolt; Impetus and Prodigious Savant no longer affect Arcane Pulse; Touch of the Archmage removed.

Fire Mage Pyroblast and Flamestrike damage increased by 15%; Apex Talent: Fired Up (Rank 1) now grants 2% increased Fire damage for 8 seconds (was 4% for 12 seconds), Rank 2 now increases Fire damage by 5%/10% (was 3%/6%), and Rank 3's chance to occur during Combustion slightly reduced. Shifts throughput out of the Combustion window into steady state.

Frost Mage Glacial Bulwark no longer grants an additional charge of Ice Barrier; all damage dealt increased by 4%; Apex Talent: Hand of Frost (Rank 2) now grants 0.5%/1% increased spell damage (was 1%/2%).
Monk (class-wide) Chi Transfer now causes Touch of Death to heal you for 60% of damage it deals (was 50%); Vigorous Expulsion increases Expel Harm's healing by 6% (was 5%).

Brewmaster Monk Stagger reduction from Staggering Strikes increased by 25%; Spirit of the Ox healing sphere generation chance increased by 20%; Celestial Brew and Celestial Infusion absorb increased by 25%; Awakening Spirit's maximum absorb increased by 25%; Vital Flame heals for 50% of Fire or Nature damage dealt (was 40%). Self-sustain rescaling alongside the +25% player-health change.

Mistweaver Monk New Talent: Vital Expenditure - Soothing Mist's healing increased by 300% but its mana cost increased by 200%, on a choice node with Dancing Mists; all healing reduced by 3%; Mastery: Gust of Mist healing increased by 50%; Spinning Crane Kick damage decreased by 15%; Way of the Crane now transfers 280% of damage done (was 340%); Jadefire Teachings now increases Ancient Teaching's transfer amount by 320% (was 270%). Intended to make Mastery more viable and shift throughput out of Spinning Crane Kick into Ancient Teachings.

Windwalker Monk Melee auto-attack damage increased by 30%; Zenith Stomp damage reduced by 30%; Blackout Kick damage increased by 50%; Tiger Palm damage increased by 200%; Dual Threat damage increased by 30%; Weapon of Wind now increases damage during Zenith by 5% (was 10%); Tigereye Brew now increases critical strike damage by 5%/10% (was 10%/20%); Conduit of the Celestials Celestial Conduit damage reduced by 25% and Temple Training now increases Fists of Fury and Spinning Crane Kick damage by 30% (was 10%). Reduces the gap between steady-state damage and burst.
Paladin (class-wide) Golden Path, Lightforged Blessing, and Brought to Light healing increased by 25%; Lightsmith Rite of Adjuration healing increased by 25%.

Protection Paladin New Talent: Blessed Word - Word of Glory can no longer critically strike but its healing is increased by your critical strike chance, and 80% of its overhealing on you becomes an absorb shield; Improved Ardent Defender redesigned - now increases maximum health by 20% while active and no longer cancels early on fatal damage; Seal of Reprisal redesigned - Blessed Hammer reduces enemy damage dealt to you by 10% for 8 seconds; Masterwork updated - after a Holy Armament your next 3 Hammer of the Righteous/Blessed Hammer/Crusader Strike casts bestow a Lesser Armament on an ally; Sentinel duration increased to 20 seconds, moved, and now inherits Avenging Wrath's critical strike bonus; Sanctified Wrath removed.

Protection Paladin Judgment and Consecration damage increased by 100%; Shield of the Righteous damage increased by 150%; Hammer of the Righteous primary damage increased by 50%; Avenger's Shield damage increased by 30%; Lesser Weapon damage increased by 50%; Avenging Wrath now increases damage and healing by 10% and critical strike by 10%; Hammer of Light and Empyrean Hammer damage reduced by 33%; Divine Exaction's Divine Toll effectiveness reduced to 80% (was 150%); Undying Embers heals for 125% of Refining Fire damage (was 100%); Bulwark of Order absorb increased to 75% of Avenger's Shield damage (was 60%); Solace causes Consecration to heal for 375% of damage dealt (was 300%). Transfers power out of cooldown windows into baseline throughput.

Retribution Paladin Apex Talent: Light Within (Rank 1) now also lets Art of War and Righteous Cause each accumulate an additional time, and Rank 3 damage reduced by 25%; Art of War now increases Blade of Justice damage by 80% (was 150%); Blade of Justice damage increased by 40%; Final Verdict and Divine Storm damage increased by 15%; Templar Strike, Templar Slash, Judgment, and Hammer of Wrath damage increased by 50%; Avenging Wrath now increases damage and critical strike chance by 15% (was 20%); Divine Toll's Judgment now deals 50% increased damage (was 100%); Art of War no longer activates from additional Skyfury attacks and those attacks no longer generate Holy Power with Crusading Strikes; Crusading Strikes now increases auto-attack speed by 15% (was decreasing it by 20%); Execution Sentence radius increased to 10 yards; Templar Hammer of Light damage reduced by 30% and now costs 3 Holy Power (was 5).

Discipline Priest New Talent: Grim Deliverance - Shadow Mend heals 30% more and applies Atonement for 4 additional seconds but its cast time is increased by 0.5 seconds; Shadow Mend redesigned into a passive upgrade - Flash Heal is upgraded to Shadow Mend rather than triggering from Shadow Word: Pain damage; Apex Talent: Master the Darkness (Rank 3) updated - Mind Blast now upgrades your next Power Word: Shield to Void Shield, Void Shield's chance from Penance reduced to 25% (was 33%) and its reflect reduced to 15% (was 25%), and the talent can now accumulate 2 charges; Flash Heal healing increased by 25%; Smite damage increased by 40%; Inescapable Torment damage reduced by 30%; Penance no longer applies Atonement when cast on an ally; Greater Smite is now a 1-point talent; Oracle Unfolding Vision redesigned to jump expiring shields to an injured ally; Voidweaver Void Blast damage +25%, Voidwraith +30%, Void Infusion Atonement bonus to 75% (was 50%).

Holy Priest Divine Hymn now additionally grants Guardian Spirit while channeled, extending an existing Guardian Spirit by 5 seconds; Archon Resonant Energy redesigned - creating a Halo increases healing done by 2% for 10 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

Shadow Priest New Talent: Shadeburst - Shadowy Apparitions that reach your primary target explode for Shadow damage within 8 yards (reduced beyond 5 targets); Improved Voidform redesigned - Voidform grants an additional 5% spell damage and 2 additional uses of Void Volley; Ancient Madness redesigned - Shadow Word: Madness increases Haste during Voidform by 2% and its duration by 1.5 seconds, stacking 5 times, with the Haste lingering and decaying over 10 seconds; Voidform now grants 3 uses of Void Volley instead of Void Volley having a cooldown; Power Word: Shield absorb increased by 25%; Phantom Menace removed; Archon Focused Outburst redesigned - Void Volley deals 15% increased damage and Shadow Word: Madness during Voidform unleashes a Void Volley.

Rogue (class-wide) Thistle Tea is now a choice talent between the existing auto-casting version and a new actively-cast-only version; Atrophic Poison now reduces damage dealt by 4% (was 3%) with duration increased to 60 seconds (was 10, unchanged in PvP); Fatebound Deal Fate now has a 60% chance to grant an extra combo point when you Seal Fate (was 100%).

Assassination Rogue New Talent: Unstable Toxin - Envenom damage increased by 18% but its duration reduced by 2 seconds; Apex Talent: Implacable (Rank 1) updated - Envenom damage increased by 10% and now restores 2 Energy per combo point spent; Internal Bleeding now triggers from Kidney Shot and Rupture with damage increased by 10%; Iron Wire now silences for 5 seconds on stealth or Improved Garrote Garrotes; Dashing Scoundrel now increases weapon poison critical chance by 10% (was 5%) and grants 4% Energy generation per lethal poison; all damage dealt increased by 3%; Deathmark increases Rupture, Garrote, and Lethal Poison damage by 75% (was 100%); Kingsbane damage reduced by 15%; Shrouded Suffocation to 30% (was 20%); Avulsion to 25% (was 20%); Motivated Murderer Energy to 30% (was 20%); Rapid Injection to 20%/40% (was 15%/30%); Blindside chance reduced to 10% (was 15%) and 20% at low health (was 30%); Deadly Momentum removed.

Outlaw Rogue Improved Between the Eyes now causes Between the Eyes critical strikes to deal 2.5 times normal damage (was 3 times); Fast Action now reduces Between the Eyes' cooldown by 8 seconds (was 5) and adds 1% damage per stack; Killing Spree damage increased by 60%; Heavy Hitter increases combo-point-generating attack damage by 15%/30% (was 10%/20%); Zero In value per stack reduced to 2% (was 3%); Hidden Opportunity's Ambush chance increased to 100% of the Sinister Strike chance (was 80%).

Subtlety Rogue Relentless Strikes now generates 4 Energy per combo point spent (was 5); Shadowcraft no longer stores an additional combo point and its auto-attack frequency bonus increased to 75% (was 40%); Lingering Shadow now also applies to Shuriken Storm; Apex Talent: Ancient Arts now considers the total damage of Secret Technique when creating a shadow clone rather than only its initial hit. Aimed at reducing resource over-capping during cooldown windows.
Shaman (class-wide) Farseer Chain Lightning now hits up to 5 targets (was 3) and Farseer Lava Burst now also increases damage by a percent equal to your critical strike chance.

Elemental Shaman Power of the Maelstrom redesigned - Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning have a 15% chance to make your next Lava Burst deal 20% increased damage, stacking twice; Stormkeeper redesigned - your next 2 Lightning Bolts become instant and deal 150% increased damage, or your next 2 Chain Lightnings become instant and Elemental Overload all targets; Lava Burst and Lightning Bolt damage increased by 30% (not in PvP); Chain Lightning and Flame Shock damage increased by 60%; Tempest direct damage reduced by 20%; Ascendance now increases Elemental Overload damage by 30% (was 75%) and its bonus Lava Bursts are 50% value (was 100%); Molten Wrath reduced to 10% (was 15%); Apex Talent: Feedback Loop (Rank 1) now +10% Elemental Overload (was 35%) plus 10% Elemental damage, Rank 2 now 15%/30% critical damage (was 25%/50%); Elemental Blast from Fusion of the Elements now grants 40% buff duration (was 100%); Stormbringer Supercharge redesigned - Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Tempest overloads deal 10% additional damage.
Enhancement Shaman Healing Surge, Earth Shield, and Healing Stream Totem healing increased by 25%. Self-sustain rescaling alongside the +25% player-health change.

Restoration Shaman Healing Rain now has a 12 second cooldown and an 18 second duration, and recasting it despawns the previous one; this cooldown change does not affect the Totemic Surging Totem's Healing Rain.

Warlock (class-wide) Summon Demonic Gateway is now a Utility spell by default in the Cooldown Manager; Hellcaller Blackened Soul redesigned - if the target is afflicted with your Wither, Chaos Bolt and Shadowburn increase its stack count by 1, and each stack gain has a chance to collapse Wither, consuming a stack every second to deal Shadowflame damage until 1 stack remains; Mark of Peroth'arn redesigned - Wither critical strikes deal 215% damage and Blackened Soul critical strikes deal 225% instead of the usual 200%.

Destruction Warlock Conflagration of Chaos redesigned - Conflagrate and Shadowburn have a 100% chance to critically strike and their damage is increased by your critical strike chance; Apex Talent: Embers of Nihilam (Rank 1) tooltip now shows the percent chance of Incinerate evoking an Echo of Sargeras.

Warrior (class-wide) The Rend ability is now exclusive to Arms, has returned to being single-target, and its Rage cost is reduced to 10; Cleave applies Rend to all targets if the Warrior knows Rend; New Talent (Fury): Storm of Blood - Whirlwind applies Rend to all targets, and Crashing Thunder extends it to Thunder Clap for Mountain Thane; New Talent (Protection): Blood and Thunder - Thunder Clap applies Rend to all targets; Thunder Clap no longer innately applies Rend if known.

Arms Warrior Ravager damage increased by 50%, no longer increases Cleave and Whirlwind damage, now causes enemies it damages to take 25% increased Bleed damage for 12 seconds, and its duration is no longer reduced by Haste; Bloodletting updated - abilities have a 5% increased critical chance against Rend targets, Mortal Strike inflicts Rend below 35% health, and Deep Wounds lasts 33% longer; Broad Strokes now grants 6 stacks of Sweeping Strikes on Colossus Smash; Improved Sweeping Strikes removed; Mass Execution and Overpowering Finish are now a choice node; Colossus Tide of Battle now increases Overpower and Execute damage, Demolish cooldown reduced to 30 seconds (was 45), and Dominance of the Colossus no longer reduces it.

Fury Warrior Whirlwind now generates 3 Rage innately and Improved Whirlwind instead adds 1 Rage per target hit up to 8; New Talent: Carving Blades - Whirlwind deals 50% additional damage against a single target, on a choice node with Meat Cleaver; Rampaging Ruin redesigned - while Improved Whirlwind is active, Rampage's final strike slams the ground for Physical damage within 8 yards (reduced beyond 5 targets); Hack and Slash updated - Rampage now has a 75% chance to refund a Raging Blow charge and increase its damage by 20%; Mountain Thane Thunder Blast damage increased by 40% and Crashing Thunder reduced to 10% Thunder Clap damage (was 30%).

Protection Warrior Devastating Focus now increases Revenge and Execute damage to the target (was Revenge only); Bloodborne now increases all Bleed damage (was only Rend and Deep Wounds); Fueled by Violence heals you for 125% of Bleed damage dealt (was 110%); Ignore Pain absorb increased by 25%; Brutal Vitality adds 10% of damage dealt to Ignore Pain (was 8%); Ravager damage increased by 50%, no longer increases Revenge and Thunder Clap damage, now causes enemies it damages to take 25% increased Bleed damage for 12 seconds, and its duration is no longer Haste-reduced; Colossus Demolish cooldown reduced to 30 seconds (was 45) and Tide of Battle now increases Revenge and Execute damage; Mountain Thane Thunder Blast damage increased by 40% and Crashing Thunder reduced to 10% (was 30%).
